thread:
Marta (Eng): hey @people-ops — quick payroll/tax question. My RSUs vested 2026-02-28, which was two days after I moved from CA -> UK. Payroll withheld US federal taxes on the vest. Do we reverse and run UK PAYE instead? worried about being double-taxed.
Julian (People Ops): hi Marta — thanks for flagging. can you confirm move date and the timestamp you updated your address? also did you enroll in UK payroll before 2/28?
Marta (Eng): moved physically on 2026-02-26; updated address in Ripley on 2/26 morning. I also uploaded passport + right-to-work docs same day. not sure about payroll enrollment flow — I thought that takes a week.
Priya (Payroll): @Marta thanks. Did the vesting payment hit the US payroll run on 2/28 (i.e., included in pay run pr-20260228)? If yes, we can do a reversing adjustment and reprocess under UK payroll, but need confirmation of NI/UTR or that you were UK tax resident on the vest date.
Marta (Eng): yes, paystub shows the RSU line in pr-20260228. I haven't given NI/UTR here in thread — happy to DM.
Alicia (Tax Counsel): high-level: tax residency determines primary taxing right for employment income. If Marta was UK tax resident on the vest date and the services were performed outside the US, PAYE should apply. US withholding may be refundable via an amended US return or foreign tax credit. We'll need to check treaty positions. Not advice for filing — we'll loop in our external payroll tax advisor.
Priya (Payroll): noted. @Julian can you confirm People Ops recorded the relocation effective date as 2/26 in the HR system? We need that stamp to justify reallocation of withholding. If HR change is logged before the payroll cut-off for the 2/28 run, we might already have a case to do a payroll reversal+reissue.
Julian (People Ops): checked — relocation record created 2026-02-26 10:12 UTC by People Ops. Enrollment to UK payroll was initiated same day but final enrollment completed 2026-03-04 (our system shows).
Priya (Payroll): that complicates it: enrollment completed after the vest date. payroll policy: PAYE requires enrolment to be active before payment date to correctly withhold. We'll still process a reversing adjustment, but external tax advisor will need to confirm whether UK PAYE can be applied retroactively.
payroll-bot: ```run_id: pr-20260228
status: completed
entries: 238
notes: RSU_VEST_MARTA amount 12,000.00 USD
withholding: federal 3,000.00 USD; state 0.00 USD
adjustment_flag: reversal_requested```
Marta (Eng): ah — I see. if UK PAYE can't be applied retroactively, is my remedy the foreign tax credit on my 2026 US return? worried about cashflow if refund takes months.
Alicia (Tax Counsel): yes, foreign tax credit is one route. Another is requesting an expedited refund through amended payroll filings if the tax advisor recommends it. We'll set up a call with the external payroll tax partner and include cashflow options (e.g., payroll advance or temporary reimbursement policy).
Priya (Payroll): action items: 1) Payroll to submit reversal request for pr-20260228 — status: pending external approval. 2) People Ops/Tax to confirm residency/treaty position. 3) Marta to DM NI/UTR (or confirm if she wants us to request on her behalf).
Julian (People Ops): I've created the internal ticket PO-2026-451 and assigned to Priya + Alicia. Adding Marta to ticket.
Marta (Eng): thanks all. I'll DM NI and scanned docs now. Appreciate quick help :heart:
Priya (Payroll): once we have NI/UTR and sign-off from tax counsel we'll try to do reversal + reprocess under UK payroll or alternatively process manual remediation. I'll post updates in ticket. :pray:
Alicia (Tax Counsel): scheduling call with external advisor for tomorrow 09:30 GMT. adding calendar invite to the ticket.
payroll-bot: update: ``reversal_request_status: submitted to tax-advisor; expected_tat: 10 business days``
Julian (People Ops): closing loop here for now — we'll keep thread updates minimal and continue in PO-2026-451. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
